Context Text: Seventeen factual questions about COVID-19 -- transmission and prevention routes, incubation, common symptoms, warning signs, the information helpline, higher-risk groups, correct hand-washing, mask and glove types, use and disposal, home care of a patient, and whether the flu vaccine protects against COVID-19. Scored 0 = completely incorrect or does not know, 1 = partially correct, 2 = completely correct.
Notes: 354 Spanish adolescents aged 12-18, recruited in Aragon (Spain) for the Spanish validation of Honarvar et al.'s COVID-19 KAP questionnaire (Aguilar-Latorre et al. 2022, Front Psychol 12:804531; data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14748660, CC BY 4.0). Administered in Spanish. Item text is in the deposit's companion meaning file but is HELD on rights -- see instrument_rights_register.csv.

Context Text: Ten questions on how far preventive measures are observed in the community and by the respondent, perceived susceptibility, fear for oneself and for one's family, perceived dangerousness of the disease, readiness to be tested, felt responsibility for others' health, and the pandemic's negative effect on daily life. Five-point scale, Nada (1) to Mucho (5).
Notes: 354 Spanish adolescents aged 12-18, recruited in Aragon (Spain) for the Spanish validation of Honarvar et al.'s COVID-19 KAP questionnaire (Aguilar-Latorre et al. 2022, Front Psychol 12:804531; data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14748660, CC BY 4.0). Administered in Spanish. Item text is in the deposit's companion meaning file but is HELD on rights -- see instrument_rights_register.csv.

Context Text: Thirteen self-reported preventive behaviours -- hand-washing and disinfecting, avoiding touching the face, mask use, covering sneezes and coughs, separate disposal of masks and tissues, disinfecting surfaces, shaking hands, kissing, hugging, keeping 1-1.5 m distance, following COVID-19 news, teaching others about prevention, and cooking eggs and meat thoroughly. Five-point frequency scale, Nunca (1) to Siempre (5).
Notes: 354 Spanish adolescents aged 12-18, recruited in Aragon (Spain) for the Spanish validation of Honarvar et al.'s COVID-19 KAP questionnaire (Aguilar-Latorre et al. 2022, Front Psychol 12:804531; data Zenodo 10.5281/zenodo.14748660, CC BY 4.0).
